sonnet.problem: The true/false statement tests two claims at once: that the Negev and foothills were inhabited, and that Jerusalem and its towns were empty. Only the second claim is false, and a baker can't tell which part is being tested.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The card says 'None of this is news' and presents the commands in 7:9-10 as words God already proclaimed through the earlier prophets. Verse 7 only asks 'Are these not the words…' and never says which words they are, and verse 12 doesn't link them to 7:9-10 either. The card ties the two passages together beyond what the text states.
sonnet.rule: When he connects two passages, or explains what a law was for, he says only what the texts state.

sonnet.problem: The choice card asks about 7:11-12 before any story card has told those verses. The card before it covers 7:10, and the story card for 7:11 only comes after. The baker has no setup and can only guess how the people responded.
sonnet.rule: A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
